Laurey 38204, Highline Cabinet Knob in Satin Brass

The 1-3/8 Inch Highline Satin Brass Knob has a unique design that is ideal for transitional kitchens. The Highline Cabinet Knob comes packaged with the mounting hardware. The Highline Cabinet Knob in Satin Brass has a rich finish that is sure to add a point of interest to any kitchen cabinet.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Highline Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 38204 Satin Brass Highline Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Brass
  • Diameter: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available finishes:
Satin Brass Oil Rubbed Bronze Satin Nickel

Sold Individually
